description: Local translation models for multilingual text translation

models.name: facebook/m2m100_418M
models.notes: Encoder-decoder seq2seq translation model. Must use transformers pipeline, not chat completions.

models.name: utter-project/EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct
models.notes: Causal instruction model. Use vLLM/SGLang or verified Ollama quantization. Translation via chat prompting.

models.name: google/madlad400-3b-mt
models.notes: Encoder-decoder T5-based translation model. Safe v1 API is text-to-text translation via transformers.

models.name: google/translategemma-4b-it
models.notes: TranslateGemma HuggingFace ID mapped to the Ollama translategemma:4b tag for Ollama-backed startup scripts.
